description:
The adopter guides that teach the linked-checkout workflow state the write stance that
governs it and where a repository declares that stance.

## Background

The parallel-work tutorial and the multi-agent coordination guide teach mutation from a linked
checkout as the sanctioned workflow. With a refusing default governing that workflow, a reader
following either page in a repository that has declared nothing meets a refusal the pages
never mention, and the opt-in path the refusal names is undiscoverable from the only pages
that teach the workflow it governs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The parallel-work tutorial states the stance that governs mutation inside a linked checkout and where a repository declares it, and every step it instructs succeeds under the stance it tells the reader to declare.
- [hard] REQ-02: The multi-agent coordination guide states the same stance where it presents linked-checkout writes as the sanctioned path.
title: State the linked-checkout write stance in the worktree guides
